span.label: how learning changes the stimulus selectivity and the mutual interactions of pyramidal cells and three classes of GABAergic interneuron at once
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: whether an interneuron class responds and changes as one functional unit, and whether learning can make a specific class selective for the behaviorally relevant stimulus
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: PV cells become as selective as pyramidal cells and less tied to the local network, PYR-PV subnetworks emerge, and SOM cells decouple and appear to gate how much any pyramidal cell can change
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: SOM interneurons gate pyramidal-cell plasticity: dendritic inhibition arriving together with bottom-up drive blocks the pairing of top-down and bottom-up inputs, so strongly SOM-coupled pyramidal cells cannot increase selectivity
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: Concurrent SOM-mediated apical dendritic inhibition prevents the association of visual and top-down inputs in pyramidal cells
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: Plasticity of excitatory connections onto PV cells makes them integrate local pyramidal input selectively, forming stimulus-specific PYR-PV subnetworks
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: PYR to PV interaction weights become specific for stimulus preference, so PV cells integrate selectively from the pyramidal cells that share their preference rather than from the neighbourhood at large
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: and the increased PV selectivity then feeds back - deleting PV to PYR weights reduces pyramidal selectivity more after learning than before
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: SOM cells inhibit apical dendrites, so a pyramidal cell whose activity is correlated with the SOM population receives dendritic inhibition timed with its bottom-up drive and cannot pair it with top-down input
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Quotation withheld, and the activity of SOM cells became strongly decorrelated, so they seemed to become uncoupled from the local network
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The proposed local versus long-range connectivity account of the PV and SOM changes is a hypothesis the study did not test directly.
span.note: what this limits: the connectivity account of the PV and SOM changes: THESE HYPOTHESES COULD BE TESTED DIRECTLY BY ASSESSING THE LOCAL AND LONG-RANGE CONNECTIVITY ... IN NAIVE AND EXPERT MICE - named as future work
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The study cannot say how much of the observed single-cell heterogeneity is explained by cell-type diversity within an interneuron class, or how it varies by brain state and region.
span.note: what this limits: any reading of the single-cell variability: THE CHALLENGE FOR FUTURE STUDIES IS TO ESTABLISH THE EXTENT TO WHICH THE HETEROGENEOUS BEHAVIOR OF SINGLE CELLS IS CAPTURED BY THE DIVERSITY OF CELL TYPES WITHIN AN INTERNEURON CLASS
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the two accounts of PV selectivity - external drive against selective local input - are separated by a prediction about co-fluctuations rather than by a manipulation
span.note: what this limits: the mechanism behind the PV selectivity change: PV CELLS MIGHT BECOME MORE STRONGLY INFLUENCED BY EXTERNAL ... INPUTS ... ALTERNATIVELY, INDIVIDUAL PV CELLS MIGHT ACQUIRE MORE SELECTIVE INPUT FROM SUBSETS OF PYR CELLS - two accounts, no measurement between them
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: and the connectivity the model infers has not been measured; the direct test is named as future work
span.note: duplicate of: limitations[0] · what this limits: the same scope as item 0 - the inferred connectivity has not been measured
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.
